name: CNSIG Anhui Hongsifang Fertilizer Co., Ltd.
summary: CNSIG Anhui Hongsifang Fertilizer Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, sale, and service of compound and nitrogen fertilizer products in China. It offers conventional compound fertilizers, crop-specific fertilizers, new specialty fertilizers, including controlled-release fertilizers, controlled-release compound fertilizers, various functional synergistic fertilizers, and water-soluble fertilizers; and nitrogen fertilizers, such as urea, urea-ammonium nitrogen fertilizers, and agricultural ammonium sulfate.
